speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, could you please describe the nature of your abdominal pain and its duration? Also, have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: I am concerned about the combination of weight loss, night sweats, and lymphadenopathy; have you noticed any specific enlargement of your neck or armpit lymph nodes? Additionally, do you have any fever or a history of tuberculosis exposure?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of painless, fixed supraclavicular lymphadenopathy with B symptoms (night sweats, weight loss, fatigue) is highly suggestive of this malignancy. I am requesting a CT scan of the neck, chest, abdomen, and pelvis to assess the extent of lymphadenopathy, along with a biopsy of the node for confirmation. REQUEST IMAGES.
